description: Log in with email + password. Returns a bearer `token` (reusable until `token_expires_at`, 1 year by default or `token_ttl_days`; remembered for the rest of this MCP session). NOTE: accounts created via register_account have NO password by default — keep using the token from register instead. To be able to log in later, call `set_password` once while still authenticated with your register token. Requires: a password set earlier with set_password. Typical error: 401 invalid credentials (register_account accounts have no password until set_password).

email.description: Required. Email of an existing account, e.g. "ops@yourcompany.com".

password.description: Required. Account password set earlier with set_password (accounts from register_account have none by default).

name: login
title: Log in
